user.title: Connect OpenAI Codex
user.description: Start the secure OpenAI device authorization flow. Your password is never sent to Home Assistant.

device.title: Authorize Codex Usage
device.description:
1. Open [{verification_url}]({verification_url}).
2. Enter code **{user_code}**.
3. Return here, check the box, and submit. Device codes expire after approximately 15 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect OpenAI Codex
reauth_confirm.description:
1. Open [{verification_url}]({verification_url}).
2. Enter code **{user_code}**.
3. Return here, check the box, and submit.

workspace.title: Select a ChatGPT workspace
workspace.description: Choose the workspace this Home Assistant entry should monitor.

error.authorization_pending: Authorization is not complete yet. Finish it in the browser and submit again.
error.device_auth_disabled: Device-code login is disabled for this account or workspace. Enable it in ChatGPT security or workspace settings.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while communicating with OpenAI.

abort.already_configured: This ChatGPT workspace is already configured.
abort.device_auth_disabled: Device-code login is disabled for this account or workspace.
abort.device_flow_expired: The device authorization expired. Start again.

init.title: Codex Usage options
init.description: OpenAI may rate-limit excessive polling. The recommended interval is 300 seconds.
